openingComparison.method: Exact RGB pixel hashes of visible movie crop in 120 consecutive HTTP captures, same moving OP segment. Captures are throughput-limited and were collected in separate sessions. These are desktop observations, not physical-watch FPS or a controlled hardware benchmark.
